title: Bread to Chili Dog
description: Changes bread to chili dog from Sonic series
body: This texture pack changes bread to chili dog, as well as its name in english and russian. This is my first texture pack I've made back in 2023. (originally uploaded to PMC) It works on 1.17.1 and higher. I've made new screenshots for this pack on Minecraft 1.20.1 and it worked without any troubles. Hope you enjoy.
